description: Preview or start a volume wind-down: absolute-minute volume steps, then pause. Set dry_run to preview without replacing or cancelling an active timer.

device_id.description: Target device id; defaults to the active device

dry_run.description: Preview only: describe what would change without performing it. Default false — pass true to preview.

floor_volume.description: Volume floor the ramp never goes below (default 10)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: schedule_wind_down
